name: Raven's Eye
review:
Raven's Eye is a 30-line druid slot with mystery symbols and a bonus game featuring Mystery Collect.

Thunderkick rates it Medium volatility, with a 1,761x cap and a 96.1% RTP.

Mystery symbols reveal matching icons to line up 30-line wins, and the Mystery Collect bonus gathers values together. A gentle, atmospheric druid game.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
